description: Represents a Kubernetes resource in an Amazon EKS cluster.

EksClusterName.description: The name of the Amazon EKS cluster where the Kubernetes resource resides.

K8sNamespace.description: The Kubernetes namespace where the resource is located. For cluster-scoped resources, this is omitted.

K8sResourceKind.description: The kind of Kubernetes resource, such as 'Pod', 'Deployment', 'Service', etc.

K8sResourceName.description: The name of the Kubernetes resource.
